info.title: Harméa API contract
info.description: G1: Docker runtime, liveness/readiness checks and reverse-proxy trust. R3: admin products, SQL statistics and streamed CSV behind ADMIN_ENABLED. R2: device cart and photo normalization. R1: guest checkout without accounts, order lookup by order number + phone and fail-closed admin gate. MySQL 8.4 via mysql2. Planned operations are not runtime implementations.

post.summary: Record the customer declaration that a transfer was made.
post.description: Static QR is displayed after checkout. This endpoint verifies order number and phone using the shared lookup rate limiter. It records an immutable, idempotent declaration event; it does not mark the order as paid or change production status. Cancelled orders return 409.
